justification: Standard: a new module that decides yes, no or no answer for state map layers the area check will use. Not Minor: it is law-adjacent logic with a staleness rule. Not Critical: nothing calls it yet, so no served answer changes in this pull request; wiring it in is the next pull request, behind a side-by-side comparison.

pre_impl.existing_data: data/law/maps holds 8 layer files and manifest.json (read_on 2026-11-18) with sha256 and feature counts. TOD Sites has 9,597 polygons, 1 of them zero area. Read on 2026-11-20: all 8 layers load and index in 2.2 seconds.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: I expected live to stall today. Over 800 live calls the slowest was 0.74 s and the median 0.11 to 0.18 s, so the value of the copy is protection in a bad hour, not a faster average. The one copy-versus-live difference in 800 points was a point exactly on a polygon edge, made by my edge sampler.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: lmr_area_inputs._layer asks the live service per lot and the database copy covers other layers; nothing read data/law/maps. This reader returns the same point and lot answer shape plus as_of and near_edge, so the rules do not change.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: this module makes no network call. A missing, corrupt, wrong-count, empty or out-of-date file gives None, which the caller treats as ask the live map.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A copy that fails its hash or feature count answers, an old copy answers, an empty layer is read as clear, a lot overlapping an edge is read as clear, or a point near an edge is not flagged.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Six deliberate breaks of the module (age check off, hash check off, count check off, lot never overlaps, edge flag off, empty layer allowed) each failed at least one test.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: 13 tests pass, including one on the 8 real committed layer files.

functions.name: MapCopy.check
functions.input: a layer key, a point and an optional lot outline
functions.output: point hit, lot overlap, copy date and near-edge flag
functions.if_none: no proven fresh copy gives None, never a clear; no lot outline gives lot None

functions.name: MapCopy._load
functions.input: the manifest name of one saved layer
functions.output: the polygons with their attributes after hash and count checks
functions.if_none: missing, corrupt or wrong-count files give None and a log line

functions.name: MapCopy.noise_bands
functions.input: a point and optional lot outline
functions.output: the airport noise bands touched, in the shape the live reader returns
functions.if_none: None means ask the live map; an empty list means the copy says none touched

values.read_at: MAX_AGE_DAYS in services/lmr_map_copy.py, owner approved 45 days on 2026-11-20
values.if_missing: a copy with no readable read_on date is no answer

values.read_at: EDGE_M in services/lmr_map_copy.py, an engineering tolerance

break_it.scenario: The saved file is altered or truncated.
break_it.what_happens: A wrong polygon set could clear a lot that is on the map.
break_it.how: The sha256 and the feature count must match the manifest, otherwise the layer is no answer.

break_it.scenario: The copy is older than 45 days.
break_it.what_happens: A new TOD site could be missing and the lot read as clear.
break_it.how: An older copy is no answer, so the caller asks the live map; the limit day itself is accepted.

break_it.scenario: The point is within a few metres of a polygon edge.
break_it.what_happens: The copy and the live map can differ by a few metres at an edge.
break_it.how: The answer carries near_edge true so the caller confirms on the live map.

break_it.scenario: The lot straddles a polygon edge with its point outside.
break_it.what_happens: The lot would be read as clear.
break_it.how: The lot overlap is tested separately and returned as lot true.

break_it.scenario: The layer file is empty or holds only zero-area shapes.
break_it.what_happens: An empty layer would read as clear everywhere.
break_it.how: An empty layer is no answer; zero-area polygons are counted and skipped, and the count must still match the manifest.
